card.name: Most or many starting a noun phrase
card.fires_on: Quantifier words such as Many, Most, or all, usually capitalized at the start of a sentence or after a conjunction. They come right before a plural noun or "of" in general web prose.

modes.label: Sentence-initial quantifier
modes.description: Many or Most opens a sentence, before a group noun or "of these".
modes.example: What is spina bifida? Spina bifida is a birth defect.<< Most>> children who have spina bifida do

modes.label: Quantifier after a conjunction
modes.description: Lowercase most or all follows "and" or "but" and leads into "people" or "of".
modes.example: honu'ea are endangered under the U.S. Endangered Species Act and<< most>> people

card.writes: It promotes "people" and "of" as the next word and suppresses other quantifiers like many, several, and all.
card.plain: It marks words like "most" or "many" that begin a phrase about a group, where "people" or "of" comes next.
